name: Ferienwohnung Margreiter
beschreibung:
Conveniently yet quietly situated in Kufstein, Ferienwohnung Margreiter provides modern comfort for couples and families.

Historic Kufstein Fortress, the town square, riverside paths along the Inn, and trailheads into the Kaiser mountains are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Margreiter in Kufstein offers central holiday living and mountain views in the historic fortress town.
